description.en: Mecha Collection Kamen Rider Series 3rd Battle Hopper is here!

description.ja: • 手のひらサイズで精密なディテールのメカコレクションから仮面ライダーシリーズ バトルホッパーが登場！
description.en: • Kamen Rider series Battle Hopper is now available from the palm-sized and precisely detailed mechanical collection!

description.ja: • メカコレならではの精密ディテールでハリケーンを忠実再現！
description.en: • Faithfully reproduces the hurricane with precision details unique to mechanical collection!

description.ja: • 水転写式デカールでマシンのマーキングを再現！
description.en: • Reproduce the markings of the machine with water transfer decals!

description.ja: • バトルホッパーに跨る仮面ライダーBLACKも単色成形で付属！ライダーベルトやマスクも忠実に再現。
description.en: • Kamen Rider BLACK astride the Battle Hopper is also included in single color molding! The rider belt and mask are also faithfully reproduced.

description.ja: • パッケージは裏返すことで簡単にディスプレイ台座に変身！
description.en: • Easily transform the package into a display pedestal by flipping it over!
